tools.name: split_epub
tools.description: Split an EPUB. With a chapter range (chapterStart and/or chapterEnd) the result is ONE base64-encoded EPUB of exactly those chapters, in order, with the book's metadata, a table of contents limited to them and the fonts and images they use. Without a range the result is a base64-encoded ZIP archive
